selection_metric: Equal-weight mean validation net return, unchanged

screen_gate.ranking: Only net_initial_equity_change may pass against the unchanged net_log_equity control
screen_gate.scope: Selected/final gain >=2pp; final stock and ETF gain >=0; drawdown worsening <=2pp. No falling-stock labels select checkpoints.

constraints.features_actions_costs_reward: Same seven features, execution_full state, native PPO, wide initialization, costs/actions/starts/discount/GAE; only reward kind changes.
constraints.short_side: Reconciled reporting on all symbols; ex-post negative-holding stock labels are reporting-only
constraints.success_claim: Development promotion is not independent confirmation or permission to trade
constraints.source: One frozen committed source for every smoke/screen/confirmation cell; export shares original ledger and allocation lock
constraints.normalization: Same immutable training-only normalizer and complete 26-symbol development panel for all arms

execution.preflight: 512-step CPU Colab smoke for each reward; actual default Python check first
execution.cleanup: Retrieve and validate artifacts; verify owned teardown; retain selected/final weights and curves; publish checksums before removing duplicates

name: reward-objectives-2026-10-20
hypothesis: Initial-capital net equity changes may better match cross-episode arithmetic-return selection than log changes; discounting and finite rollout bootstrapping still prevent exact terminal-objective equivalence.

rewards.net_initial_equity_change: (current-previous)/initial_equity; no extra insolvency sentinel, side bonus, or penalty
rewards.discounting: Keep native gamma/GAE identical. Undiscounted telescoping is an accounting identity, not a claim about discounted PPO optimization.
